text: Look at this article, Trang. Scientists have discovered a new exoplanet.
Really? Is it in our solar system?
No, it's far away. But they say it's in the habitable zone.
You mean it could have liquid water and support life?
Exactly. It's similar to Earth in size and temperature.
Do you think there are aliens living there?
Who knows? Maybe they are more advanced than us and travel in flying saucers.
I'd love to travel into space and explore other planets.
Me too. But right now, we can only explore them through powerful telescopes.
